session.weekdays_and_exchange_holidays: Use NYSE calendar; exclude holidays and early-close days
session.missing_bar_policy: Only score complete 78-bar sessions; report all excluded sessions
session.close_positions: At 16:00 local session close; never carry overnight or over weekends

signal_execution.late_entries: No fresh entry during final 15 minutes
signal_execution.forced_exit: Last bar close at 16:00 local time

methods.definition: First six bars define high/low; enter long after a completed close above the range or short below; hold until opposite breakout or session end.
Long when close is above session VWAP and EMA(9)>EMA(21); short when below VWAP and EMA(9)<EMA(21); otherwise flat.
Compute z=(close-session_VWAP)/rolling_20_bar_std(close-session_VWAP), min 10 observations; enter long at z<=-2 or short at z>=2; exit when z crosses 0; reverse only at the opposite entry threshold.
Direction of close/close_12_bars_ago - 1; flat until 12 completed bars exist; all thresholds and parameters frozen.

costs.fee_model: Taker on every entry and exit, including reversals
costs.funding: Apply OKX realized historical funding only where the official funding-history endpoint supplies coverage; explicitly flag the endpoint's three-month coverage ceiling and prohibit promotion if backtest funding coverage is incomplete.

methodology_amendment.supersedes: HARMONY-PEPE-SESSION-001 for session-filter validation only; prior outputs remain preserved
methodology_amendment.change: Use each NYSE calendar date's scheduled open and close in America/New_York; exclude early-close sessions rather than treating 24/7 PEPE candles through 16:00 as regular-session data.
methodology_amendment.reason: Source audit found that v1 checked session dates but ignored scheduled closing times.
